build_wheel_package: build a python wheel package from source files and headers with project name and platform
create_prepare_wheel_srcs: create a function that rearranges source and header files into a target directory for wheel building
run_patch_so_files: run patchelf to fix rpath in .so files so auditwheel passes
test_copy_file_with_strip: test copying a file to a destination directory with optional prefix stripping and custom dest path
review_parse_args_cli: review the argparse CLI parser that accepts --output-name, --project-name, --platform, --srcs, --headers, --dests, --version, and --tf-version
